command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged inputs against their pinned sha256 =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 9b43da92651b35814597af6a8b18f500b768679a49fa4678224f384917ce7668 ensembl116_pep.fa.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' e6732c4cf4fda1dd831e78cb9c0416c6357d6e462ec8ec75cac690801ab153a7 queries1000.fa
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

# makeblastdb cannot read gzip. gzip is a base-image utility, not a second
# scientific tool: makeblastdb and blastp are both BLAST+, so this is one tool.
gzip -dc ensembl116_pep.fa.gz > pep.fa

echo "== makeblastdb: Ensembl 116 human proteome =="
makeblastdb -in pep.fa -dbtype prot -out pepdb -title ensembl116_pep
blastdbcmd -db pepdb -info > dbinfo.txt
cat dbinfo.txt

echo "== blastp: 1000 queries vs the whole proteome =="
T0=$(date +%s)
blastp -query queries1000.fa -db pepdb \
  -outfmt '6 qseqid sseqid pident length qlen evalue bitscore' \
  -max_target_seqs 500 -num_threads 16 -out hits.tsv
T1=$(date +%s); SEARCH_S=$(( T1 - T0 ))
echo "search_wall_s $SEARCH_S"

# ---- smoke check ----
# The queries ARE the first 1000 records of the database, so each one must find itself. At 20
# queries that read as "every query gets a full-length 100% self-hit", and that is NOT what BLAST
# guarantees -- measured at 1000 queries, 102 of 931 self-alignments stop exactly ONE residue
# short of the query (terminal proline is enriched 3.6x among them, 50/102 against 137/1000
# overall; the mechanism is not established here). So the exact claim is split from the
# data-dependent one:
#   exact      -- every query that hits anything hits ITSELF, at 100.000% identity
#   observed   -- how many of those self-alignments span the whole query
DBSEQS=$(awk '/sequences;/ {gsub(/,/,"",$1); print $1; exit}' dbinfo.txt)
ROWS=$(wc -l < hits.tsv | tr -d ' ')
QWITHHITS=$(cut -f1 hits.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SELFROWS=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==$2{print $1}' hits.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
SELF100=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==$2 && $3==100.000{print $1}' hits.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
FULLSELF=$(awk -F'\t' '$1==$2 && $3==100.000 && $4==$5{print $1}' hits.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
{
  echo "search_wall_s         $SEARCH_S   (blastp only, 16 threads)"
  echo "db_sequences          $DBSEQS   want exactly 382428"
  echo "queries               1000"
  echo "queries_with_any_hit  $QWITHHITS   want >= 900 (69 are short peptides that miss the e-value cutoff)"
  echo "self_rows             $SELFROWS   want == queries_with_any_hit (EXACT: a hit set containing itself)"
  echo "self_rows_100pct      $SELF100   want == self_rows (EXACT: a sequence is 100% identical to itself)"
  echo "full_length_self      $FULLSELF   OBSERVATION: 102 of 931 stop one residue short; see note"
  echo "hit_rows              $ROWS"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$DBSEQS" -eq 382428
test "$QWITHHITS" -ge 900
test "$SELFROWS" -eq "$QWITHHITS"
test "$SELF100"  -eq "$SELFROWS"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
